meta.name: audit
meta.description: Audit a website or web codebase for SEO and AI-search (GEO/AEO) — produces two independent 0-100 scores (Search SEO + AI Visibility) plus a prioritized, evidence-backed report. Read-only; never writes files. Use when the user asks to audit, analyze, check, or score a site's SEO, structured data/schema, meta tags, Core Web Vitals, robots.txt, sitemaps, or llms.txt, or how it ranks in Google and is cited by AI engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Claude).
